name: The Sparklematic 5200!
summary: In Gnomeregan, the Sparklematic 5200! keeps cleaning salvaged valuables for three silver coins. Gnomish ingenuity keeps it working amid the ruined city's chaos.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Grime
sections.body: A pocket of surviving gnomes holds a secure perimeter near the Sparklematic 5200! in Gnomeregan. The machine scrubs harsh subterranean filth from salvaged valuables. Troggs and other subterranean creatures pound on the bulkheads, yet it remains ready for what you bring.

sections.title: Frenzied Operation
sections.body: Place a grime-caked relic and three silver coins in the Sparklematic, and the cleaning begins. The iron machine groans and vibrates, lurching as it strips away toxic sludge, irradiated grease, and rock dust. Moments later, it expels what lay beneath the muck, from precious minerals to mechanical components.

faq.answer: The Sparklematic 5200! is an automated gnomish cleaning machine in a protected pocket of Gnomeregan. It strips radioactive grease, sludge, and dirt from encrusted items recovered in the fallen city.

faq.q: What does the machine require to operate?
aliases: what do i put in sparklematic
faq.answer: The Sparklematic needs a Grime-Encrusted Object found among Gnomeregan's monsters and debris, along with three silver coins in its coin slot.

faq.q: Why is there an operational machine in the middle of a war zone?
faq.answer: Surviving gnomes withdrew to fortified workshops after the trogg invasion and toxic vents devastated Gnomeregan. Machines such as the Sparklematic remained intact and powered there, preserving the convenience of gnomish automated tools.

faq.q: What comes out after cleaning a grime-encrusted item?
aliases: what do you get from sparklematic
faq.answer: The Sparklematic returns the salvaged item cleaned, revealing what lay beneath the muck. That may be trade supplies, crafting stones, gems, or spare engineering parts.

faq.q: Can I use the Sparklematic 5200 more than once?
aliases: can i clean multiple grime items
faq.answer: Yes. You can use the Sparklematic repeatedly, bringing more grime-encrusted objects and three silver coins for each cleaning.

faq.q: Why does the machine shake so violently during cleaning?
faq.answer: Gnomeregan's encrusted filth is dense, toxic, and hardened. The Sparklematic's agitation and internal scrubbers shear it away, making the chassis lurch and groan.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see your people's resilience in a cleaning machine that keeps working amid the devastation of their homeland.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the motor and sorting mechanism that clean and process unknown debris without jamming or exploding.
As an Alliance member, you can use the Sparklematic to clean salvaged relics in Gnomeregan before carrying them back to Ironforge.
